speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant finding; however, Guillain-Barré syndrome typically presents with ascending muscle weakness rather than primary respiratory distress. Given your confirmed nerve conduction abnormalities, have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or speaking clearly?

text: No, I haven't had any trouble swallowing or speaking clearly. My main issue is just that I feel incredibly weak and can't seem to get enough air even when I'm resting. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Guillain-Barré Syndrome with impending respiratory failure.
